habit.description: Winds up a big heavy punch whenever you are in her face. Block it, then hit her back while she recovers.

notes: Row-1 apprentice (YOK-174), its own profile; no temperament roll. Schema has no 'apprentice' temperament, so temperament is 'aggressive' (it walks in) and yokai 'kitsune' (the kit it plays as); the node must name id 'apprentice' directly. Habit: heavy punch (startup 10f, recovery 20f) at close range 60%: one slow, clear tell and a wide punish window, teaches block-then-punish. No Foxfire: the zoning game is the Kitsune yokai's, and projectiles would keep a newcomer at range and cause timeouts. Throw is rare (10) so throw-break is seen but not constant. It never blocks, so a newcomer's hits land and fights end by KO. No EX or burst (E22). One jump answer (heavy punch, 30). Expected habit frequency: 60% of close-range decisions. Damage per duel is judged by the harness against Y4 (110 newcomer / 80 average, half damage per hit); expected near those, to be verified.
